scope: Independent offline accounting/recovery review; no paid models, no native launch, no implementation files changed by reviewer.
native_boundary_status: Not reviewed in this assignment; deliberate fail-closed lack of native capability is not a regression and this report does not certify live readiness.

independent_final_attempt1.reservation_crash_test_adaptation: Original counterexample preserved in initial log/probe. Updated SIGKILL stub uses new required durable admission_intent before Meter.reserve, matching repaired launch order.

findings.title: Reservation-only crash prevents recovery
findings.why: Meter.reserve is persisted before Budget.admit. SIGKILL in that interval leaves no budget row. Recovery never visits the meter-only job; its $12 remains falsely live, and next_job_id reuses the occupied ID so the next reservation raises duplicate monetary admission.
findings.repro: test_sigkill_after_meter_reserve_before_budget_admit_is_recoverable; actual subprocess SIGKILL after durable reserve and before budget admit
findings.expected: Reconcile both journals, terminalize or explicitly cancel orphan admissions, retain counters according to their actual dispatch/admission state, and never reuse a monetary identity.
findings.resolution: Scheduler now durably records admission intent before monetary reserve. Actual SIGKILL at intent+reserve but before Budget.admit recovers one interrupted admission and frees allowance; next ID is fresh. Unexplained meter entries without intent fail closed.

findings.title: Codex native receipt was charged again under retry job identity
findings.why: Original candidate keyed Codex receipt identity by job ID as well as epoch and total. Same native epoch/request/total replayed under retry job captured $0.02 for one $0.01 native receipt.
findings.resolution: Explicit native epoch identity now global; own counterexample passes.

findings.title: Repeated pending boundary bypassed elapsed and cap checks
findings.why: Original pending-ID branch returned True before current time, unresolved and cap checks; same pending ID at elapsed 2400 seconds was still authorized.
findings.resolution: Checks now precede replay success; own counterexample passes.

findings.title: Conflicting Codex duplicate usage silently validated
findings.why: Original dedup early return accepted same epoch/total with contradictory last categories and left no unresolved record.
findings.resolution: Duplicate categories validation now rejects and retains unresolved; own counterexample passes.

findings.title: Campaign silently creates zero-captured meter despite historical budget
findings.why: A valid continuation Budget imported from original premium history does not require its monetary baseline. Missing priced journal auto-creates captured=0/history=None and admits J0005 despite original captured $39.718066, allowing lifetime cap to reset if initialization is incomplete.
findings.repro: test_campaign_rejects_missing_lifetime_meter_import_before_admission; uses real historical Budget and real campaign with dispatch replaced by a raising local stub
findings.expected: Before any new admission require matching, hash-bound imported monetary history for the budget arm; reject absent or mismatched baseline.
findings.resolution: campaign now rejects missing monetary journal/history before admission and validates history identity. Own missing-baseline campaign counterexample passes.

findings.title: Wall clock consumes human waiting as processing time
findings.why: Budget.check computes time.time minus continuation_started_at; interrupted outcome uses recovery time minus admission. Scheduler-down/human waiting consumes four-hour allowance and is represented as job elapsed, although the brief says processing time excludes human waiting.
findings.repro: Static code evidence; continuation start + four hours denies even when most of interval was human waiting. Existing scheduler tests explicitly assert this wall-clock behavior.
findings.expected: Durably track authorized processing elapsed without resetting it, retain down/unknown intervals separately and do not fabricate execution time for downtime.
findings.resolution: Durable verified_human_waits intervals are validated, unioned and excluded. Independent restart test preserves original start and computes 14000 processing seconds from 15000 elapsed minus 1000 documented wait. Unknown downtime remains conservatively charged; parent explicitly required no invented human-wait exclusions.

verified: Same-arm/stage cold allowance $12 until two fully reconciled samples; no cross-arm pooling (supplied tests independently run).
Lifetime cap identity $250 premium/$100 hybrid and 12 additional admissions/14400-second start retention (supplied tests independently run).
Normal actual SIGKILL with real Meter, Budget and flow.finish retains .03 captured then fresh retry reaches .035; completed receipt bytes unchanged and no duplicate receipt entries.
Unknown interrupted request remains unresolved and uncharged; no live allowance remains for terminal interrupted job.
Repeated recovery does not duplicate terminal receipt or finish effects.
Original premium and hybrid raw histories unchanged after import/recovery, original counters preserved, hybrid J0012 elapsed remains null.
limitations: Offline stubs do not establish provider request-boundary enforcement or live transport cancellation.
Independent test covers actual SIGKILL with real Meter/Budget/finish; worker and transport are stubs.
Pass is restricted to listed files/hashes and reviewed counterexamples. Native adapter work is concurrent and outside this pass.
